login.title: Sign in to Trip Planner
login.subtitle: Enter your email and we'll send you a sign-in code.
login.sent: Sent! Check your inbox and enter the code below.
login.error: Couldn't send the code. Please try again.
login.callbackError: That sign-in link is invalid or expired. Request a new one and open it in the same browser you requested it from (not your mail app's built-in browser).
login.codeError: That code is wrong or expired. Please request a new one.

welcome.title: Trip Planner
welcome.empty: No trips yet. Create your first one!

trip.name: Trip name
trip.destinationsHint: The first destination auto-fills time zone and currency. You can still change them.
trip.dateError: End date can't be before start date.
trip.comingSoon: Daily plans arrive in the next milestone.
trip.deleteConfirm: Delete this trip? All plans will be removed and this can't be undone.
trip.searchUnavailable: Destination search is unavailable (Google key needed). Type a name and press Enter to add it, then pick the timezone and currency yourself.

share.title: Sharing
share.regenerateHint: The old link stops working immediately.
share.hint: Invitees must verify their email and only see plans they're part of.

avail.title: Make a plan
avail.public: Public free-time link (no verification to view; email is verified when sending a request)
avail.hint: Only free slots are shown — never plan titles, places or people. A leaked link exposes when you're free, so rotate it when needed.
avail.publicOff: Not public yet — tick the public option above first.

people.title: People
people.name: Name
people.hint: Email is used for invites and to verify viewers. Only people marked “Can view everything” see all plans; everyone else sees only plans they're in.

hotel.title: Stays
hotel.none: No hotels yet. Add your first one!
hotel.name: Name
hotel.todoPh: e.g. compare prices, ask about luggage storage
hotel.outsideTrip: This stay is outside the trip dates
hotel.tzNote: Times are in trip local time ({tz})
hotel.noHotels: No hotels yet — nights without one will be flagged in red.

plan.title: Title
plan.noPeople: No people yet. Add some in trip settings.

visHint.normal: Invitees see their own plans; full-access viewers see everything.
visHint.participants_only: Only you and listed participants can see it; full-access viewers not on the plan can't.
visHint.owner_only: Only you can see it. You can't invite people.

plan.dragHint: Drag a card to move it to another day
plan.timeError: Duration must be at least 30 minutes.
plan.tzNote: Times are in trip local time ({tz})
plan.photosLocked: Mark the plan complete to add photos.
plan.swipeHint: Swipe sideways to change day; use the menu under a card to move it.
plan.totalIncludes: = photographer fee + studio fee + other items
plan.planTodoPh: e.g. book, buy tickets, prepare props

commute.manualOnly: This method can't be estimated. Enter the time manually.
commute.needPlaces: Fill in origin and destination first.
commute.errNotConfigured: Google Maps key (GOOGLE_MAPS_SERVER_KEY) isn't configured. Enter the time manually.
commute.errNoRoute: No route found. Enter the time manually.
commute.errGeneric: Estimate failed. Try again or enter it manually.
commute.errRate: Too many estimates. Try again shortly.
commute.tzNote: Times are in trip local time ({tz})

fx.rateOverrideHint: 1 {cur} = ? USD. When set, {cur} amounts convert to USD at this rate (completed plans still use their completion-day rate).

dash.title: Dashboard
dash.generalPh: e.g. exchange yen, buy a SIM
dash.noRate: {n} item(s) left out: no exchange rate
dash.scoreHint: Completed plans only; time spent together with you.

viewer.title: Trip itinerary
viewer.emailHint: Enter your invited email and we'll send you a 6-digit code.
viewer.codeSent: If {email} is on the invite list, a code has been sent (valid for 10 minutes).

err.tooMany: Too many attempts. Try again in an hour.
err.config: This page is unavailable right now.
err.wrongCode: That code is wrong or has expired.
err.locked: Too many wrong codes. Please request a new one.

viewer.noPlans: You have no plans on this trip yet.
viewer.configMissing: Server isn't configured (needs SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY and VIEWER_COOKIE_SECRET).

invite.title: Send an invite
invite.icsLinkHint: The copy button on the right copies the calendar link — time and place only, no costs or people.

export.failed: Export failed. Please try again (photos may not have loaded).

errors.title: Something went wrong
errors.body: Please try again. If it keeps happening, reload the page.
errors.notFoundBody: The link may have expired, or you may not have access.

free.title: {trip}: make a plan with me
free.subtitle: Pick a free slot, verify your email, and send a request.
free.pick: Tap a slot to get started.
free.name: Your name
free.sent: Sent! You'll get an email once they decide.
free.verifyHint: Enter your email and we'll send a 6-digit code.

err.invalid: Something's missing — please check and try again.
err.blocked: Your request can't be sent right now.
err.tooMany: Too many requests today. Please try again tomorrow.
err.pendingLimit: You already have 3 pending requests. Please wait for a reply.
err.slotTaken: That slot was just taken. Please pick another.
err.session: Your verification expired. Please verify again.

err.conflict: That slot is no longer free, so it can't be accepted.
err.failed: Something went wrong. Please try again.

todos.title: To-dos
todos.titlePh: e.g. book the studio, exchange cash
todos.categoriesHint: Create your own categories (e.g. luggage, bookings, gifts) to organise every to-do. Built-in Hotel, Ticket and Plan categories stay.
todos.deleteCategoryConfirm: Delete this category? Its to-dos are kept and go back to their built-in category.
